name: Qubool Hai
description: Zoya Farooqui, a modern NRI who travels to Bhopal searching for her father, where she falls for the traditional, stern businessman Asad Ahmed Khan.

credits_cast.character: Zoya Farooqui/Sanam Ahmed Khan/Seher Ahmed khan
credits_cast.name: Surbhi Jyoti

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Zoya is unhappy after she learns that her sister has fixed up her wedding without her consent. Meanwhile, Rashid's nervous daughter Nikhat is eager to meet her prospective husband.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Ayaan and Asad fight against Zoya's to-be fiancé Akram's goons. Asad gets stabbed and is admitted to a hospital. Asad’s father Rashid visits him in the hospital after 17 years.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Asad doesn't respond positively to Rashid's concern as he is unhappy with Rashid's second marriage. Asad flinches and leaves the hospital with his mother Dilshad.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Razia fills doubts in Shireen's mind that Rashid is trying to see his first wife Dilshad under the pretext of meeting Asad. Ayaan is unhappy with Rashid's submissiveness to Gaffur.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Not able to be at peace, Rashid wishes to meet Asad and know about his well-being. Therefore, he calls up Dilshad and asks her if he may visit Asad at her residence.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Zoya again bumps into Asad, which leads to a funny altercation. Rashid is not able to leave home to visit Asad as Nikhat's prospective groom and family come to visit her.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The confirmation of Nikhat's engagement with Imraan delights everyone. Rashid gets uneasy as he isn't able to visit Asad. Dilshad is equally saddened as Rashid doesn't turn up.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Asad deletes a voicemail from Rashid, in which he seeks Dilshad's forgiveness. Anwar and Zeenat contemplate how risky it is to let Zoya stay and find the truth about her past.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Ayaan is angered by the fairness creams that Nikhat's groom's family has sent. He is advised by Razia and Shireen to control his anger. Zoya mistakenly settles in Asad's bedroom.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Asad is surprised when he finds Zoya in his bedroom. Asad makes Dilshad promise that she will move on from her past life. Rashid awaits Dilshad's call.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: An unattended call made by Ayaan to Asad is received by Rashid, and he finds Dilshad on the line. Zoya chases Ayaan on a bike to teach him a lesson after he litters in the market.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Asad is concerned that Zoya's disrespectful conduct will influence Najma. But Dilshad asks Asad to be more tolerant. Zoya asks Najma to identify a building from a half-burnt photo.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Imraan's mother gets upset to see the price tag still intact on their return gifts. Gaffur lectures Rashid to set right his son Ayaan's conduct.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Asad, Zoya and Ayaan discuss their preferences for their potential partner. Dilshad runs into Rashid at the shrine, to which she has come to pray on their 31st wedding anniversary.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Zoya's effort to make her happy delights Dilshad. Rashid lies to Shireen about being at the office. Just then, Imraan's mom comes to exchange the tux offered by Rashid's kin.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: A bubbly Zoya confronts Asad on his many objections regarding her and her stay. Haseena reads the name of Asad Ahmed Khan on the bill while trying to get the tux exchanged.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Shireen confronts Rashid about his whereabouts as he was lying. But Badi Bi covers up for Rashid. Haseena indirectly asks who is Asad Khan. Dilshad receives a gift from Rashid.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Shireen confronts Rashid about his whereabouts as he was lying. But Badi Bi covers up for Rashid. Haseena indirectly asks who is Asad Khan. Dilshad receives a gift from Rashid.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Zoya goes to a shrine and cries over Asad's harsh comments after he bails her out of jail. Zoya meets Rashid at a shrine and offers to help him get back with his departed love.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Zoya hides Najma's short hair by placing a wig on it and stamps Asad's feet when he tries to check it. Everyone in college waits excitedly to see Zoya.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Zoya enters Najma's college in a burka and encourages a diffident Humeira to go on stage. Haseena demands that Rashid gift Imraan a luxury car.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Rashid requests an old song to be played on the radio anonymously for Dilshad. Haseena rushes into Dilshad's house asking for an unknown person to see who her husband is.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Haseena learns about Asad's identity. Asad is annoyed to say the voice password set by Zoya every time to receive a call. Razia prompts Shireen to make Ayaan wed Humeira.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Asad approaches Zoya furiously and asks her to fix his phone. He breaks it into pieces in a fit of anger. Razia sees Rashid trying to call Dilshad.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Razia grabs Rashid's phone and makes Shireen note down the last called number. Zoya falls in Asad's arms after they both wish the worst for each other under the shooting stars.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Ayaan finally confesses taking monetary help from Asad to buy gifts. Zoya calls Rashid and asks him to come to the same market that she is visiting with Dilshad.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Haseena asks her brother Feroze to secretly find out what's the relationship between Asad and Ayaan. Zoya shares with Dilshad that she remembers her long-lost mother on seeing her.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Senior cop Feroze stops Ayaan and learns that his new bike is registered in Asad's name. Asad sees Najma and Zoya on TV in the evening at a cricket podium. He gets angry.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Razia proposes to Rashid and Shireen that Ayaan and Humeira get married. Asad scolds Najma after she lies about going to the cricket match, and suggests that Zoya leave the house.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Asad fights against goons to bring Zoya back home. When Ayaan goes to buy the items for Nikhat's engagement ritual, the cops stop him for illegal driving.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Asad warns Feroze against holding Ayaan unlawfully without a warrant. Just as Haseena claims that she wants to break off the engagement, Ayaan reaches home.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Razia decides to use Asad to stop Rashid and Dilshad from meeting each other. Zoya unintentionally puts Asad's important CD and the cake mixture in it into the microwave.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Shireen is shocked and hurt to see Rashid holding Dilshad's hand. Razia passes very unpleasant comments to Dilshad which Asad counter attacks and takes Dilshad back home.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Zoya realises her blunder when she cuts the cake and finds a CD. Rashid gets furious at Razia for publicising his personal affairs. Razia responds suitably.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Shireen vainly tries to sway Rashid towards her and distract him from Dilshad. Humeira has a romantic online chat with a college mate, assuming it is Ayaan on the other side.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Shireen vainly tries to sway Rashid towards her and distract him from Dilshad. Humeira has a romantic online chat with a college mate, assuming it is Ayaan on the other side.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Dilshad and Najma stop Akram and Zoya from seeing each other in front of Asad. Haseena avoids talking about what was bugging her when she gets the keys to a luxury car from Razia.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Asad clarifies that he is not breaking Elena's heart, but only a deal. Humeira realises that her date is with a college friend and not Ayaan. She tries to run away from him.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Asad confronts Zoya when he learns that she had walked out of her wedding with Akram. Razia insists on getting Nikhat married to Imraan despite Haseena's unending greediness.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Akram comes with his goons to meet Zoya and declares that he will complete their wedding forcibly. Humeira is saved by Ayaan from her harasser, who forces himself upon Humeira.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Zoya is drugged and trapped by Akram's family so that she can be forcibly married to him. Razia tries to convince Rashid that Ayaan and Humeira are a perfect couple.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Asad prevents Zoya from being forcibly married to Akram. He fights all the goons and takes Zoya back home. Everyone surprises Shireen with a birthday party.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Rashid falls unconscious. Later, Dilshad tells him that she has forgiven him for everything. Asad tries his best to help Zoya even after she lectures him.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Rashid continues to play along and celebrates Shireen's birthday when he sees a present in his pocket placed by Ayaan for Shireen. Zoya misses listening to Asad's apology.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Zoya tries to sneak into Asad's room at night in the dark to find her earrings. Asad assumes that the silhouette is that of Ayaan's and hence talks to it and hugs it. He then realises that it is Zoya. Zoya declares that she will tell everyone about Asad's secret. Asad does not want his mom to know that he meets his step-brothers and step-sisters despite his mother telling him not to meet with members of Rashid's family. Haseena tips off Feroze after Ayaan leaves the engagement ring at her house.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Zoya blackmails Asad and makes him fulfil her demands. Ayaan is abducted by Feroze and rescued by Asad at the cost of Haseena knowing about their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Zoya increasingly suspects that Asad is a secret agent. Humeira is made to promise by a bruised Ayaan that she would not tell anyone that he is hurt.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Ayaan comes to Asad secretly at night to show him Feroz's gun. Zoya sees the silhouette of Ayaan in Asad's bedroom and decides to find out.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Badi decides to prevent Gaffur from making the declaration of Ayaan's engagement. Asad confirms that Feroze and Haseena are related, and that's why Feroze was tailing them.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Haseena calls off Imraan's engagement with Nikhat deeming it unsuitable because of Rashid's association with Asad. Later, Gaffur warns Dilshad to keep Asad away from Ayaan.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Ayaan defends his relationship with Asad and tells his family how Asad had saved him. Further, Dilshad and Shireen want Asad and Ayaan to sever ties with each other.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Asad and Ayaan vow to their mothers to sever all ties with each other. Further, Asad believes that Zoya told Dilshad about him meeting Ayaan, and he orders Zoya to leave his house.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Asad learns that Gaffur told Dilshad about his meetings with Ayaan. He rushes home and asks Zoya to not leave. Further, Asad offers Haseena a house to ensure Nikhat's engagement.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Asad is determined to protect his siblings and ensure their happiness, even if it were from a distance. Further, Nikhat and Imraan exchange engagement rings.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Asad rushes to see Ayaan, who has been hospitalised. However, Asad is reminded of his promise and turns away from Ayaan. Later, Zoya learns about Rashid and his families.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Zoya kidnaps Ayaan from the hospital so that Ayaan and Asad can meet. Rashid takes Ayaan away from Asad by force. Later, a furious Asad warns Zoya against interfering in his life.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Dilshad wants Asad and Zoya to attend a wedding, but they refuse to do so. Due to a series of unfortunate events, Zoya and Asad end up on the same tractor en route to Mangalpur.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Asad and Zoya arrive at Mangalpur, but Asad wants Zoya to return to Bhopal. Elsewhere, Razia intoxicates Humeira and Ayaan and locks them in a room together.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Razia ensures that Ayaan and Humeira are found in bed together. Elsewhere, Zoya learns that Mariam is being forced to marry a rapist. Zoya further helps Mariam escape.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Zoya escapes with Asad's help. When they seek help from the police, the police arrest them and lock them up together. Asad and Zoya escape, however, some goons follow them.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: When Zoya falls unconscious, some goons surround Asad. Further, Dilavar and his goons bury an unconscious Zoya alive. Asad is desperate to save Zoya.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Asad saves Zoya, who comes back to life in his arms. Elsewhere, Ayaan and Humeira’s indiscretion makes their family members angry.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Asad and Zoya return to Bhopal. Asad is tormented by his feelings for Zoya. Elsewhere, Humeira and Ayaan are tricked into attending their engagement ceremony.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Ayaan and Humeira realise that they have been tricked into attending their engagement ceremony. Further, Ayaan and Humeira, though unwilling, are about to exchange rings.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Nikhat stops Ayaan and Humeira's engagement and provides evidence that they did not sleep with each other. Further, Badi Bi asserts that Ayaan and Humeira do not want to marry.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Humeira declares that she does not want to marry Ayaan. Elsewhere, Asad warns Zoya against contacting Mariam. Later, Zoya catches Mariam sneaking into Asad's house.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Razia reminds Rashid that she knows about the crime that he had committed 17 years ago. Meanwhile, Nikhat comforts a heartbroken Humeira. Later, Zoya hides Mariam in the storeroom.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Ayaan is livid about Rashid's decision to not leave Razia's house. Zoya tries to ensure that Mariam's presence in Asad's house is not noticed. Razia sneaks into Rashid's room.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Asad, who realises that Zoya has been hiding Mariam, decides that Mariam needs to be sent away. Later, Dilshad brings Mariam into the house, much to Zoya's surprise.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Dilshad learns that Rashid has been burdened by a secret for years. Further, a man enters Asad's house with a gun and in her attempt to save Mariam, Dilshad gets shot.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Asad rushes Dilshad to the hospital. Further, Dilshad's doctor advises Asad that their relatives should be informed. Asad informs Rashid that Dilshad is fighting for her life.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Rashid arrives at the hospital to meet Dilshad, whose heartbeats soon strengthen. Dilshad survives and is out of danger. Further, Asad initiates police action against Dilavar.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Shireen comforts a sobbing Rashid who is relieved that Dilshad has survived. Elsewhere, Asad blames Zoya for Dilshad's shooting and forbids her from meeting Dilshad.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Dilshad tells Asad that she was the one who bought Mariam into the house. Further, Asad apologises to Zoya for his behaviour. However, when Zoya tries to comfort him, he walks off.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Asad and Zoya realise that the gunman was aiming to kill Dilshad. Elsewhere, Razia and Gaffur discuss their failure at having Dilshad killed. Badi Bi questions Razia about Dilshad.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Badi Bi's suspicions about Razia being responsible for the attack on Dilshad deepen. Elsewhere, Zoya and Asad trace the security firm that employed Dilshad's assailant.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Razia admits to Badi Bi about wanting Dilshad dead. Elsewhere, Rashid meets Dilshad but refuses to answer her questions in order to protect her from harm.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Razia frames Badi Bi as a liar and evades her own confession of attacking Dilshad. Elsewhere, Asad and Zoya try to find Dilshad's attacker through the gun he used.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Asad and Zoya question the suspects of the attack on Dilshad. They meet the final suspect, Raghu Singh, who recognises Zoya and flees before Asad can catch him.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Zoya and Asad are told that Raghu Singh, Dilshad's attacker has committed suicide. However, Zoya recognises Raghu at a shop and follows him as he walks towards a mansion.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Dilshad tells Asad that Rashid is trapped in a lie, but Asad refuses to believe her. Elsewhere, Badi Bi finds photographs of Rashid setting fire to the factory.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Razia recalls how she committed a murder and led Rashid into believing that he killed someone as a result of setting a factory on fire. Asad and Zoya continue their investigation.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Asad finds Rashid in the doll factory and thinks that Rashid shot Dilshad to hide the crimes he committed seventeen years ago. Asad is determined to make Rashid pay for his crimes.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Rashid realises that Razia tried to kill Dilshad and in his fury, gets close to killing Razia. The police officers arrive to arrest Rashid for murder and arson on Asad's orders.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Asad and Dilshad remain firm in their differing beliefs about Rashid's innocence. Further, Dilshad promises Rashid that she will find evidence to prove his innocence.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Dilshad and Shireen are desperate to help Rashid and set him free. Further, Asad remains firm though Zoya, Dilshad and Ayaan try to convince him not to testify against Rashid.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Asad learns about Zoya's fear of fire and her nightmares of being trapped in a burning building. Further, Asad learns that Zoya is in Bhopal to find the father she has never known.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Razia sneaks inside Asad's house and learns of the recorded confession in the doll. Further, Zoya receives a letter, summoning him to testify against Rashid in court.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Razia suspends Badi Bi by her feet as a warning against her quest to expose Razia. Further, Asad confronts Zoya about hiding the court letter, asking him to testify against Rashid.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Zoya and Ayaan make a plan to stop Asad from testifying against Rashid. Further, Asad and Zoya find a framed photograph in an abandoned house that matches the one Zoya has.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Razia gets threatening messages to confess her crimes before it is too late. Elsewhere, Ayaan and Zoya put their plan into action to stop Asad from testifying against Rashid.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Zoya and Ayaan work together to ensure that Asad's car breaks down. Asad and Zoya find shelter in an abandoned house and later eat the weed laced fritters that Zoya bought.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Zoya and Asad are intoxicated and confess their feelings for each other. Elsewhere, Badi Bi tricks Razia into confessing to her and Gaffur's framing Rashid for their crime.

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: Razia injures Badi Bi by throwing her down a flight of stairs. Elsewhere, Rashid doesn't get bail. Zoya meets with an accident, and Asad rushes to the site but embraces a girl.

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: Asad's old friend, Tanveer, is invited to stay with the family, making Zoya uncomfortable. Further, Ayaan learns about Rashid being tortured and seeks Asad help for their father.

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: Razia is desperate to get and destroy the doll with the evidence that will exonerate Rashid. Elsewhere, Zoya is irritated and jealous of Tanveer's close bond with Asad.

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: Shireen, desperate to find a large amount of money to bail Rashid out of jail, instructs Ayaan to sell off her properties. Zoya is held responsible for a gas leak in Asad's house.

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview: Humeira tricks Gaffur into signing the property papers for Ayaan. However, the papers are intercepted by Razia who offers them to Ayaan in exchange for his marriage to Humeira.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: Zoya's special dish for Asad induces a severe allergic reaction to the peanuts in it, but Zoya saves him. Further, Shireen seeks help from Dilshad for Rashid's safety.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: Tanveer, Najma and Zoya bring the doll to Asad to dissuade him from testifying against Rashid. However, when he plays the audio recording, it asserts Rashid's guilt.

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: Rashid is set free as a result of Ayaan's deal with Razia to marry Humeira. Further, Razia destroys the original audio recording, brought to her by Tanveer, the real Billo Rani.

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: Rashid is determined to leave Razia and Gaffur's house. Further, Rashid learns about Ayaan taking money from Razia. Badi Bi shocks everyone by supporting Razia.

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: Zoya is revealed to be the illegitimate daughter of Gaffur and Zainab Farooqui. It is further disclosed that Razia killed Zainab and put Zoya in an orphanage seventeen years ago.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: Feroz's statement about Asad sending Rashid to jail for revenge surfaces. Elsewhere, Tanveer slips away from Zoya. However, a worried Zoya returns to find Tanveer home already.

videos.title: Episode 105
videos.overview: Badi Bi gets her revenge for the physical harm that Razia caused her. Elsewhere, Tanveer realises that she is pregnant. Later, Tanveer calls Razia for help, but she declines.

videos.title: Episode 106
videos.overview: Tanveer tells Imraan that she is pregnant, but he refuses to take responsibility. Further, Razia's insinuations about her lineage stoke Tanveer's aim to marry Asad for his wealth.

videos.title: Episode 107
videos.overview: Nikhat and Imraan's wedding date gets officially fixed, and Razia hopes to get Ayaan married to Humeira soon. Elsewhere, Tanveer's closeness to Asad irks a jealous Zoya.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: Zoya's search for her father leads her to a phone number. When she calls the number, Razia answers and realises that Gaffur's illegitimate daughter is indeed looking for him.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: Razia terminates Gaffur's conversation with Zoya. Razia is determined to find Zoya and keep her away from Gaffur. Asad and Ayaan resolve their differences and embrace each other.

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: Razia uses Zoya's number to call and identify her among the guests at the 'Holi' party. Further, Razia offers Tanveer money in exchange for Zoya's permanent departure from India.

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: Tanveer learns that Zoya is Gaffur's illegitimate daughter. She misdirects Zoya and uses the information to threaten Razia. Meanwhile, Nikhat tells Ayaan that Humeira loves him.

videos.title: Episode 112
videos.overview: Asad is misled into believing that Zoya's father has passed away. He takes Zoya to visit her father's grave. However, a distraught Zoya is unwilling to believe Asad.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: Zoya grieves the loss of the father she had never known and decides to leave the country. Despite wanting to, Asad doesn't dissuade her. He learns that Zoya has bought the tickets.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Razia wants Ayaan to mention the topic of his wedding to Humeira in front of the family. Elsewhere, Asad indirectly tells Zoya that he doesn't want her to leave.

videos.title: Episode 115
videos.overview: Razia adds to Shireen's fear of black magic and warns Ayaan that unless he marries Humeira soon, Shireen would get hurt. Tanveer makes Asad think that Zoya wants to leave.

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: Razia's threats force Ayaan into declaring that he wants to marry Humeira, which makes Rashid and Badi Bi suspicious. Elsewhere, Tanveer's lies result in Zoya's decision to leave.

videos.title: Episode 117
videos.overview: Asad records an impersonal message for Zoya, unaware that he continues to be recorded when he expresses his vulnerability. Later, Tanveer hears Asad's message and destroys the CD.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: Asad lies to make sure that Zoya stays back which infuriates Tanveer. Further, Zoya is summoned to the Immigration office and asked to leave in a day or be deported.

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: Razia makes Shireen think that Dilshad is practising black magic on Ayaan because she is jealous of Shireen. Further, Zoya's immigration officer arrives at Asad's house.

videos.title: Episode 120
videos.overview: Mr. Bhatawdekar is firm on deporting Zoya, but Asad stops it by lying about him and Zoya getting engaged. Elsewhere, Razia manipulates Shireen into rushing Ayaan's engagement.

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: Ayaan agrees to get engaged the next day on the condition that Asad attends the function. Ayaan informs Asad about the engagement and invites him, but Asad refuses to attend it.

videos.title: Episode 122
videos.overview: Tanveer is intent on sabotaging Humeira's engagement. Mr. Bhatawdekar drops by for an inspection at Asad's house. Elsewhere, a veiled Zoya arrives at Ayaan's engagement.

videos.title: Episode 123
videos.overview: Zoya ensures that Asad can witness Ayaan's engagement. Elsewhere, Tanveer awaits the results of her poisoned sweets. Zoya hears the tune of the orb that her father had given her.

videos.title: Episode 124
videos.overview: Zoya feeds Humeira the sweets that Tanveer had poisoned earlier. When Humeira collapses, Razia accuses Zoya of acting on Dilshad's orders to hurt Rashid's family.

videos.title: Episode 125
videos.overview: Razia refuses to listen to Zoya assert her and Dilshad's innocence. A furious Asad tells Mr. Bhatawdekar that he lied about his engagement with Zoya and allows her to be taken.

videos.title: Episode 126
videos.overview: A heartbroken Asad allows Zoya to be taken away for deportation. Dilshad informs him that everything Zoya did was for his happiness. Asad frantically looks for Zoya at the airport.

videos.title: Episode 127
videos.overview: Asad places an engagement ring on Zoya's finger and stops her from getting deported. Elsewhere, Humeira's condition worsens. Asad tells Dilshad that his engagement is fake.

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: Humeira regains consciousness. Elsewhere, Tanveer intends to electrocute Zoya. However, Asad realises that something is amiss and rushes to save Zoya.

videos.title: Episode 129
videos.overview: Asad refuses to admit his feelings for Zoya. Further, at a relative's wedding banquet, Zoya teases Asad by talking about their engagement. Rashid and his family arrive as guests.

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: Shireen accuses Dilshad of jealousy and malice. Further, Dilshad loses her temper when Shireen wishes ill for Asad. Dilshad declares that Asad shall marry within ten days.

videos.title: Episode 131
videos.overview: Dilshad wants Asad to marry Zoya within ten days. She asks Asad if he loves Zoya, to which he remains resolutely silent. Further, Tanveer declares that Asad's silence is a refusal.

videos.title: Episode 132
videos.overview: Badi Bi warns Razia that her daughter Humeira will throw her out within ten days. Elsewhere, Dilshad commands Asad to marry Zoya in ten days.

videos.title: Episode 133
videos.overview: Dilshad feigns being ill to emotionally blackmail Asad into getting married. Elsewhere, Badi Bi mocks Razia by ensuring that her hair gets cut. Later, Asad and Zoya get engaged.

videos.title: Episode 134
videos.overview: Asad and Zoya decide to stay engaged until Dilshad is well. Tanveer's pregnancy makes her nauseous, and she collapses. Tanveer feigns an anxiety attack in order to not be examined.

videos.title: Episode 135
videos.overview: Asad stops Dilshad from informing Zoya's sister about the engagement. Asad instructs Zoya to lie to Dilshad about her sister being ill. Tanveer needs to undertake a blood test.

videos.title: Episode 136
videos.overview: Zoya gets a sample of Tanveer's blood for the prescribed test. Later, Asad and Zoya's pre-wedding ritual commences. Elsewhere, Badi Bi's threats begin to make Razia nervous.

videos.title: Episode 137

videos.title: Episode 198
videos.overview: Razia gives the thief, pretending to be Vikram cash in exchange for his departure. Elsewhere, Asad tries to make Ayaan realise that he has fallen in love with Humeira.

videos.title: Episode 203
