videos.overview: Sanam reaches Aahil’s house to thank Rehan but avoids meeting him since he is with Aahil. Afterwards, the doctor advises Sanam not to let Dilshad travel.

videos.title: Episode 405
videos.overview: Dilshad takes shelter at Munisa’s residence. Later, Sanam thanks Rehan and expresses how much she loathes Aahil. However, Aahil arrives during their conversation and hears her.

videos.title: Episode 406
videos.overview: Rehan advises Sanam to apologise to Aahil. She follows his advice, but Aahil refuses to accept her apology. Further, he asks her to do chores at his house to pay off the debt.

videos.title: Episode 407
videos.overview: Sanam helps Nazia gain consciousness. However, Aahil tells her to stay away from Nazia. Afterwards, Aahil challenges Sanam to fetch his watch from a pool of water.

videos.title: Episode 408
videos.overview: Following Shazia’s direction, Sanam puts a steel container in the oven which causes it to catch fire. Sanam tries to put out the fire but gets her hand burnt during the process.

videos.title: Episode 409
videos.overview: Despite having a fever, Sanam agrees to assist Aahil at his office. When Sanam accidentally drops coffee on Aahil's documents, he punishes her.

videos.title: Episode 410
videos.overview: Sanam faints and sleeps through the night in Aahil's arms after he takes her into his office. The next day, Sanam puts Aahil's jacket in the washing machine without water.

videos.title: Episode 411
videos.overview: Sanam succeeds in Aahil's task to make 100 kg 'laddoos', but Gazalla and Razaq steal two boxes of 'laddoos' without Sanam's knowledge. Later, Shoaib makes Haya feel uncomfortable.

videos.title: Episode 412
videos.overview: When Aahil realises that Sanam is going to win the task, he cheats to make Sanam lose. Aahil then asks Sanam to apologise. Later, Munisa makes Dilshad and Haya do the housework.

videos.title: Episode 413
videos.overview: Asma secretly helps Sanam find out Aahil's foul play. Sanam denounces Aahil's deed. Later, Rahat gazes at Haya. Further, Gazalla stops Sanam from moving towards the forbidden room.

videos.title: Episode 414
videos.overview: While everyone waits for Azhar, he plays cards with his friends. Tanveer, who is addressed as Begum, arrives at the party. Later, Dilshad is shocked to learn where Sanam works.

videos.title: Episode 415
videos.overview: Aahil remembers his scarred childhood. Further, Azhar and Asma's engagement takes place. Later, Sanam forces Dilshad to come inside the 'Haveli', much to the latter's dismay.

videos.title: Episode 416
videos.overview: Dilshad remembers how Tanveer killed Najma, Asad and Zoya at the 'Haveli'. Sanam figures out that Tanveer is blind. Further, Tanveer tells Aahil to live his life on his own terms.

videos.title: Episode 417
videos.overview: After saving Haya, when Rahat chides her, Dilshad informs him that Haya is deaf and dumb. Further, Sanam unlocks the forbidden room, but Lateef does not let her enter the room.

videos.title: Episode 418
videos.overview: Munisa slaps Haya and accuses her of theft. Thereafter, Begum avoids Sanam's queries regarding the forbidden room. Later, Masood and his men plant a bomb in Aahil's room.

videos.title: Episode 419
videos.overview: The terrorists capture the bungalow and threaten to kill everyone. Aahil and Sanam manage to save everyone from the attack. When Sanam finds Badi Bi, she tries to talk to her.

videos.title: Episode 420
videos.overview: On Rehaan and others' urging, Tanveer and Aahil entrust Sanam with Badi Ammi's responsibility. Later, Gazalla and Tanveer intentionally give wrong medicines to Sanam for Badi Ammi.

videos.title: Episode 421
videos.overview: Tanveer goes to meet Dilshad and Haya. Badi Ammi falls sick after consuming the wrong medicines, and Aahil admonishes Sanam. Later, Tanveer asks Gazalla and Razaq to be careful.

videos.title: Episode 422
videos.overview: Tanveer threatens Badi Ammi with a snake for the whereabouts of the property papers. Further, Sanam saves Badi Ammi from the snake, and Rehaan praises her courageous act.

videos.title: Episode 423
videos.overview: A jealous Munisa throws away Haya's food and asks Rahat to stay away from Haya. Later, Badi Ammi tries to talk to Sanam, and an elated Sanam informs Tanveer about the improvement.

videos.title: Episode 424
videos.overview: Tanveer threatens Badi Ammi about the property papers. When Munisa goes to visit her friend, Shoaib misbehaves with Haya. Later, a distressed Haya bangs on Rahat's door for help.

videos.title: Episode 425
videos.overview: On her way back, Sanam is followed by Tanveer's men. Rahat saves Haya from Shoaib and throws him out of the house. Further, Badi Ammi asks Sanam to visit a graveyard alone.

videos.title: Episode 426
videos.overview: Sanam visits the graveyard and finds the box, which contains the will. Tanveer's men catch hold of Sanam, and Tanveer orders them to kill her. Later, Sanam loses her consciousness.

videos.title: Episode 427
videos.overview: After miscreants bury Sanam alive, Tanveer procures Nawab's will from them. Thereafter, Tanveer calls Rehaan to the graveyard. Later, Aahil reaches the graveyard to rescue Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 428
videos.overview: Aahil rescues Sanam from a grave and drives her home. Meanwhile, Tanveer reveals secrets to Rehaan and hands him a will. Later, Tanveer wonders where Sanam has hidden the will.

videos.title: Episode 429
videos.overview: Aahil and Rahat take care of Sanam and Haya. Thereafter, Tanveer instructs Gazalla and Razaq to procure Nawab's will while Sanam is unconscious and dares them to mess up.

videos.title: Episode 430
videos.overview: Eager to take over Nawab's property, Tanveer calls in the lawyer. However, things go awry for her as the lawyer declares that Aahil is the rightful owner of the property.

videos.title: Episode 431
videos.overview: Tanveer coaxes Aahil into marrying so that he owns the property. Meanwhile, at Munisa's home, Rahat is furious with Haya for changing the decor of his room and throws her out.

videos.title: Episode 432
videos.overview: Aahil is lost in thoughts and is unwilling to marry, despite Tanveer's coaxing. Later, when Nida gives Sanam clothes to wash, Sanam returns her tips and gives her a dressing down.

videos.title: Episode 433
videos.overview: Rahat repairs Haya's flower pots to make up for his misbehaviour. Later, a frustrated Aahil proposes Nida for marriage as Sanam does not express any feeling towards him.

videos.title: Episode 434
videos.overview: Nida accepts Aahil's proposal for marriage, and the couple gets engaged at Aahil's house. Meanwhile, Haya leaves a leter for Rahat, requesting to join everyone at dinner.

videos.title: Episode 435
videos.overview: A drunk Aahil blames Sanam for not understanding him. Further, Rahat surprises Munisa by joining Haya for dinner. Later, Rehaan asks Tanveer not to force Aahil to marry Nida.

videos.title: Episode 436
videos.overview: Nida tells Gazalla and Razaq that no one can stop her from marrying Aahil. Rehaan thinks of Sanam and gets interrupted by Aahil. Later, Rehaan offers a lift to Haya and Dilshad.

videos.title: Episode 437
videos.overview: Gazalla hides the dupatta under the bed, but Tanveer picks it up from the floor. Further, Rahat accepts Haya's gift and wears it. Later, Rahat scolds Haya for taking him outside.

videos.title: Episode 438
videos.overview: When Nida blames Sanam for stealing the dupatta, Tanveer defends her. Further, Haya worries about Dilshad's return. Later, Aahil tries to stop Rehaan from going with Sanam alone.

videos.title: Episode 439
videos.overview: Sanam and Rehaan go to the 'dargah', and Aahil looks at Sanam praying in the 'dargah'. Further, Rahat saves Haya from an accident. Aahil and Sanam tie a thread at the 'dargah'.

videos.title: Episode 440
videos.overview: Haya enquires Rahat about his fear of the outside world. Further, Nida purposely falls to seek Aahil's attention. Later, Nida shows a shortcut to Sanam to lead her astray.

videos.title: Episode 441
videos.overview: Sanam, who is trapped inside the laundry machine, screams for help. Further, Rahat takes Haya home. Later, Rehaan notices the broker and enquires him about Sanam's whereabouts.

videos.title: Episode 442
videos.overview: Sanam stops Aahil, who leaves her alone in the farmhouse. Munisa throws Rahat's invitation card into the dustbin. Later, Aahil notices Sanam and Rehaan hugging each other.

videos.title: Episode 443
videos.overview: Rehaan adorns Sanam's hair with 'gajra', and Aahil feels jealous. Later, the henna meant for Nida accidentally falls down and splashes across Sanam's palms.

videos.title: Episode 444
videos.overview: Nida leaves Aahil's house because Aahil refuses to fire Sanam. Further, Nida knows about Tanveer's plan and asks her for INR 5 crores in exchange for marrying Aahil.

videos.title: Episode 445
videos.overview: Aahil hears Rehaan talking to himself and learns that he loves Sanam. Elsewhere, Nida plans to acquire Aahil's properties and poisons Tanveer's soup.

videos.title: Episode 446
videos.overview: Tanveer realises that Nida tried to kill her and decides to find another bride for Aahil. Meanwhile, Rehaan tells Dilshad that he wants to marry Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 447
videos.overview: Rehaan tells Tanveer that he wants to marry Sanam. Meanwhile, Sanam decides to leave the job. Later, Tanveer meets Dilshad and tells her that she wants Sanam to marry Aahil.

videos.title: Episode 448
videos.overview: Dilshad suffers from a heart attack. Tanveer offers to pay for her treatment and wishes to marry Sanam off to Aahil. Later, Rehaan tells Aahil that he plans to propose to Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 449
videos.overview: There is a terrorist attack at the party, and Rahat rescues Haya. Elsewhere, Tanveer asks Sanam to marry Aahil. She also tells her that she can divorce him after three months.

videos.title: Episode 450
videos.overview: Tanveer ties up Nida. Meanwhile, Sanam takes Nida's place as the bride and agrees to marry Aahil. Later, Tanveer tries to convince Aahil to marry Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 451
videos.overview: Tanveer makes Aahil marry Sanam. Consequently, Rehaan's dream of marrying Sanam gets shattered. Later, Tanveer makes Aahil think that Sanam has married him for his money.

videos.title: Episode 452
videos.overview: Rehaan decides to leave the house, but Tanveer convinces him otherwise. Meanwhile, Aahil confronts Sanam about marrying him for money. Rahat and Haya leave for home.

videos.title: Episode 453
videos.overview: Tanveer asks Lateef to plan for 'iftar'. Further, she asks Aahil to submit his marriage certificate to the lawyer. Later, Sanam and Aahil feed each other to break their fast.

videos.title: Episode 454
videos.overview: Rahat finds a note from Dilshad at her residence. Meanwhile, Tanveer encounters an occultist. Later, Rahat is interrupted by Sanam when he is about to express his feelings to Haya.

videos.title: Episode 455
videos.overview: Rahat and Haya reach the hospital to see Dilshad. Gazalla informs the lawyer about Sanam and Aahil sleeping in separate rooms. Later, the lawyer reaches Aahil's residence.

videos.title: Episode 456
videos.overview: Aahil makes the lawyer believe that he loves Sanam. Aahil asks Sanam to sleep in his room to avoid people tattling about their marriage. Later, Rahat confronts Munisa.

videos.title: Episode 457
videos.overview: Tanveer’s guests argue that Sanam’s family’s stature is not as high as Aahil’s. Sanam replies that her father had been a successful businessman before he and her mother had died.

videos.title: Episode 458
videos.overview: The occultist warns Tanveer that her death is near. Further, Rahat introduces Haya to his brother, Faiz, and the two recognise each other from their earlier encounter on the road.

videos.title: Episode 459
videos.overview: Rahat and Faiz both like Haya. Meanwhile, Aahil makes Sanam wear the other set of bangles, much to Rehaan's dismay. Later, Tanveer invites an unknown lady for the 'Dawaat-e-Eid'.

videos.title: Episode 460
videos.overview: Tanveer is shocked to know that Sanam is Asad and Zoya's daughter. Further, Sanam asks Aahil to quit drinking. Later, Tanveer agrees to let Razia stay at the 'Haveli' and aid her.

videos.title: Episode 461
videos.overview: Tanveer is impolite towards Sanam. Further, as Sanam asks Tanveer and Razia about her parents, they lie to her. Later, Tanveer pays Razia to hide the truth from Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 462
videos.overview: Aahil gets jealous to see Rehaan touch Sanam. Further, Aahil hurts Sanam while dancing. Later, Aahil refuses to drink with his friends. Later, Sanam finds a secret door.

videos.title: Episode 463
videos.overview: Sanam and Rehaan enter Zoya and Asad's room, but Tanveer forbids them from entering the room again. Later, when Shoaib returns, Munisa tells Rahat that she owns the house.

videos.title: Episode 464
videos.overview: Sanam spots the locket but does not open it. Tanveer gets Zoya and Asad's room sealed. Meanwhile, Rahat, Faiz and Haya leave Munisa's house. Later, Tanveer fails to kill Dilshad.

videos.title: Episode 465
videos.overview: Rehaan tells Sanam that Asad was an opulent business person. Aahil sees Sanam hold Rehaan's hand. Later, Razia is unable to kill Dilshad as Dilshad is released? from the hospital.

videos.title: Episode 466
videos.overview: Sanam tells Lateef about a strange body ache that she often undergoes. Sanam learns that her parents did not die in a road accident. Later, Tanveer throws Razia out of the house.

videos.title: Episode 467
videos.overview: Sanam informs Aahil about her parents' death. Faiz tells Rahat about his feelings for Haya, which leaves Rahat shocked. Further, Tanveer asks Razia to stay in the servant's room.

videos.title: Episode 468
videos.overview: Sanam tells Tanveer about her parents' death, which shocks her. Haya mistakenly agrees to marry Faiz. Later, Tanveer worries about any survivors from the attack on Asad's family.

videos.title: Episode 469
videos.overview: At night, Seher cons a man on the road for money. Faiz asks Haya about her wishes for the wedding. Later, Seher talks to Tanveer, who finds the former's voice similar to Sanam's.

videos.title: Episode 470
videos.overview: Sunehri plans to con a rich man for money. Sanam learns about Haya's wedding, and Aahil agrees to attend the wedding. Further, Sunehri reaches Aahil's house to con Aahil's guests.

videos.title: Episode 471
videos.overview: Sunehri dons the look of Sheikh's wife and enters the bungalow. Sunehri plans to steal the necklace that Sheikh gave to Sanam. Later, Sunehri steals the necklace from the locker.

videos.title: Episode 472
videos.overview: Sunehri's burqa gets torn accidentally, while she tries to escape. Aahil spots Sunehri and assumes her to be Sanam. Further, Rahat asks Haya if she is happy with her wedding.

videos.title: Episode 473
videos.overview: Tanveer tells everyone about the necklace and accuses Sanam of taking it. Aahil takes Sanam's side, and she thanks him. Later, Aahil is upset to see Sanam and Rehaan together.

videos.title: Episode 474
videos.overview: Sanam and Aahil argue with each other. Tanveer desires to kill Dilshad during the wedding. Further, Haya is married off to Faiz and is stunned to see that Rahat is not the groom.

videos.title: Episode 475
videos.overview: Tanveer plants a gas vial in Dilshad's room to kill her. Dilshad is unable to escape because of physical inabilities. Later, Rahat brings Haya to Faiz before leaving for his job.

videos.title: Episode 476
videos.overview: When the vial explodes, and Aahil is fatally wounded, Sanam brings him to a hospital. Later, security guards chase Seher, who has stolen jewellery and money, to the same hospital.

videos.title: Episode 477
videos.overview: Seher donates blood to Dilshad in the hospital to hide from the guards, who are chasing her. Later, while Sanam prays to God, Seher discovers that she is her lookalike.

videos.title: Episode 478
videos.overview: Aahil wants to return home from the hospital as soon as he regains consciousness. Later, Seher tries to dupe a rich and childless couple at a cafe, but Rehaan interrupts her.

videos.title: Episode 479
videos.overview: Seher runs away from Rehaan somehow and hides behind his car. Meanwhile, Salima arrives at Aahil's house and rebukes him for marrying a deaf and mute girl like Haya.

videos.title: Episode 480
videos.overview: Sanam falls in Rehaan's arms, and Aahil misunderstands him, which results in a confrontation between them. Faiz pretends before Salima that his conjugal life is running smoothly.

videos.title: Episode 481
videos.overview: Aahil wants to send Rehaan away on a project to prevent him from meeting Sanam. Meanwhile, Salima finds out that Faiz had been acting and that his conjugal life does not exist.

videos.title: Episode 482
videos.overview: Tanveer comes to Aahil's room and says that the property papers are ready for signing. However, Aahil cannot sign due to severe pain in his hand. Later, Rehaan runs over Seher.

videos.title: Episode 483
videos.overview: Tanveer tells Sanam that she has decided to send Dilshad to Shimla. Further, Sanam helps Aahil to change the bandage. Later, Tanveer belittles Sanam for winning the competition.

videos.title: Episode 484
videos.overview: Rehaan gets irritated by Sunehri's gibberish talk. While Dilshad leaves for Shimla, Haya and Tanveer bid her goodbye. Further, Aahil and Sanam participate in the competition.

videos.title: Episode 485
videos.overview: Aahil gets mesmerised to look at Sanam. Tanveer gets surprised to learn that Aahil and Sanam won the compatibility test. Later, Rehaan scolds Sunehri for her drama.

videos.title: Episode 486
videos.overview: Tanveer decides to keep a close eye on Razia. Further, Sunehri asks Rehaan to hire her as his secretary. Later, Aahil and Sanam spend quality time with each other.

videos.title: Episode 487
videos.overview: A killer informs Tanveer that Dilshad fled after the accident. Further, Sunehri tries to open the safe but stops to hear footsteps. Later, Sanam swears to know about Aahil's past.

videos.title: Episode 488
videos.overview: Phupi searches Haya's room to find out about her lover. Further, when Sunehri talks to Rehaan, he gets charmed by her. Later, Phupi decides to plot against Haya to evict her.

videos.title: Episode 489
videos.overview: Rehaan asks Sunehri to accompany him to a meeting. Sanam learns that Razia's cousin is suffering from paralysis. Later, Rehaan sees a dead man lying on the road.

videos.title: Episode 490
videos.overview: Tanveer tells Aahil to get the divorce papers from the lawyer. Further, Razia tells Dilshad that she will destroy Tanveer. Later, Sunehri tries to steal money from the safe.

videos.title: Episode 491
videos.overview: Salma creates a misunderstanding between Haya and Faiz's director, due to which the director feels offended. Tanveer collides with Dilshad and asks Aahil to find out who it was.

videos.title: Episode 492
videos.overview: Sunehri decorates Rehaan's room on his birthday. Elsewhere, Tanveer recalls how she had shot Raza and made Aahil believe that he did it. Later, Sanam finds a whip in the attic.

videos.title: Episode 493
videos.overview: Faiz rebukes Haya, and she calls Rahat. Elsewhere, Sunehri feels reluctant to steal money from Rehaan. Later, Tanveer warns Aahil that Sanam is trying to look into his past.

videos.title: Episode 494
videos.overview: Rozy and Shishupal come to Rehaan's house. Elsewhere, Aahil asks Sanam to stop prying into his past. Further, he notices the whip in his room and gets agitated.

videos.title: Episode 495
videos.overview: Faiz divorces Haya, while Shishupal imprints Rehaan's locker key. Later, Tanveer finds out that Aahil got the property papers two days ago and gets angry as he did not inform her.

videos.title: Episode 496
videos.overview: Rahat comes back home. Shishupal and Rozy plan to rob Rehaan's house. Later, Razaq and Gazalla accidentally mix the contents of Razia's packet in an apple pie, and Aahil eats it.

videos.title: Episode 497
videos.overview: Aahil and Sanam start singing and dancing, while Dilshad falls asleep. Meanwhile, Sunehri notices that Rehaan has an additional key of the safe.

videos.title: Episode 498
videos.overview: Rehaan tells Sunehri that Tanveer never loved him. Meanwhile, Aahil tells Sanam about his past. Later, Haya tells Rahat that he is not strong enough to love anybody.

videos.title: Episode 499
videos.overview: Bhaktivash Devi, an occultist, asks Razia to bring her 100 flowers. Meanwhile, Rozy and Shishupal ask Sunehri to help them steal. Later, Sanam helps Aahil cope with his past.

videos.title: Episode 500
videos.overview: Tanveer scolds Gazalla and Razaq for failing to hamper Sanam and Aahil's relationship. Meanwhile, Faiz learns about Phupi's plot to turn him against Haya.

videos.title: Episode 501
videos.overview: Devi asks Razia to bring her the hair of a genderless person as the second task of her test. Faiz requests Rahat to marry Haya. Rehaan tells Sunehri that he loves her.

videos.title: Episode 502
videos.overview: Haya accepts Rahat’s marriage proposal. Sunehri is furious with Shishupal and Rozy and kicks them out of Rehaan's house. Tanveer urges Aahil and Sanam to sign the property papers.

videos.title: Episode 503
videos.overview: Tanveer manipulates Aahil into thinking that he can never be a good husband and that his relationship with Sanam will not last. Rahat tells Faiz that Haya is ready to marry him.

videos.title: Episode 504
videos.overview: Sanam refuses to sign the property papers without Aahil. She suspects Tanveer when her story about Aahil killing his father does not match with the story that Aahil had told her.

videos.title: Episode 505
videos.overview: Sanam steals the property documents from Tanveer's room. Meanwhile, the police arrive at Rehaan's place to arrest Sunehri while he proposes her for marriage.

videos.title: Episode 506
videos.overview: Devi tells Razia where to find Sunehri. Tanveer asks Sanam to sign the papers, but she refuses by saying that her hand is wounded. Faiz apologises to Haya for misunderstanding her.

videos.title: Episode 507
videos.overview: Razia wants Sunehri to work for her. Meanwhile, Haya asks Rahat about his conversation with Faiz. Tanveer, Gazalla and Razaq resort to violence to get Sanam's thumb impression.

videos.title: Episode 508
videos.overview: Tanveer tells Sanam that she will be bound to sign the documents and also make Aahil sign them. Razia tells Dilshad that she has found Seher. Aahil decides to apologise to Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 509
videos.overview: Dilshad is fearful of Razia and tries to inform Sanam about her. Meanwhile, Rahat and Haya go to a resort. Razia and Sunehri meet at a temple. Later, Rehaan visits the temple.

videos.title: Episode 510
videos.overview: Sanam is on her way to an event in Kohinoor hotel with Dilshad stuck behind her car. Rahat and Haya's car breaks down while going to the event. Tanveer and Aahil go to the event.

videos.title: Episode 511
videos.overview: Tanveer praises Aahil for establishing the hotel. Later, Sanam fails to talk to Aahil. Rehaan takes a veiled Dilshad inside the venue. Later, Razia tells Sunehri to hide her face.

videos.title: Episode 512
videos.overview: Dilshad comes in close contact with Sanam, Sunehri and Haya. However, the three fail to see each other at the same time. Later, Sanam tells Haya to bring Aahil to the corridor.

videos.title: Episode 513
videos.overview: Tanveer threatens to kill Aahil if Sanam tells him her truth and stops him from signing the property papers. Further, Aahil assures Sanam that their love will never change.

videos.title: Episode 514
videos.overview: Razia replaces Sanam with Sunehri, and Tanveer attempts to stab Sanam. However, she gets hurt instead. Thereafter, Sanam tries to reach out to Aahil but fails.

videos.title: Episode 515
videos.overview: Dilshad attempts to rescue Sanam, but Razia stops her. Seher enters the house as Sanam and has some recollections of the past. Sanam is not scared of Tanveer's threats.

videos.title: Episode 516
videos.overview: Tanveer has changed the clauses of the property papers. Rahat tells Faiz to drop his plan of marrying Haya. Meanwhile, Sunehri plans to hurt Tanveer but fails.

videos.title: Episode 517
videos.overview: Aahil thinks that Sanam is purposely being a tease. Haya is upset about Rahat's departure to the army. Later, when Sanam searches for a room to sleep, she has a blurry vision.

videos.title: Episode 518
videos.overview: Sanam spends the night at Gazalla and Razaq's room. Haya is confused about Faiz' actions. The next day, Aahil gifts Sanam a ring. Further, Sanam's plan to hurt Tanveer fails.

videos.title: Episode 519
videos.overview: Sunehri finds it difficult to be at peace as Rehaan's memories keep haunting her. While Aahil is excited to celebrate Diwali with Sanam, Tanveer plans to separate them.

videos.title: Episode 520
videos.overview: Sunehri is at a loss of words as Rehaan expresses the spite he bears for her. Meanwhile, Faiz saves Haya from an accident. Later, Rehaan resists accepting Tanveer's gift.

videos.title: Episode 521
videos.overview: Sunehri wonders why Razia stopped her from talking to Dilshad. Later, Aahil is shattered as Sanam withdraws herself in spite of his efforts to mend their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 522
videos.overview: Razaq comes up with a plan to kill Sanam and shares it with Tanveer. Later, Sunehri reads through Razaq and Gazalla's demeanour and tricks Razaq to have the spiked 'falooda'.

videos.title: Episode 523
videos.overview: Aahil blames Razia from the entire mishap and resolves to send her off to an old age home. Later, Sunehri takes advantage of Aahil's weakness and compels him to change his mind.

videos.title: Episode 524
videos.overview: Razia manages to save Sanam from getting caught. Further, Razia gives a letter to Sanam. Later, Tanveer gets suspicious after reading the note thrown away by Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 525
videos.overview: Gazalla and Razaq plant a spy camera in Sanam’s room. Razia asks Sunehri to get Aahil’s signature on the property papers. Later, Rahat informs Haya that he is going to marry her.

videos.title: Episode 526
videos.overview: Razia offers to pay Sunehri INR 1.5 crores to marry Aahil, but later Sunehri demands INR 2 crores from her. Thereafter, Tanveer fails to expose Sanam in front of Aahil.

videos.title: Episode 527
videos.overview: Razia and Sunehri discuss how they averted getting caught. Further, Rahat tells Faiz that Haya loves him. Later, Faiz swears never to let Haya and Rahat get close to each other.

videos.title: Episode 528
videos.overview: Faiz learns that Haya loves Rahat. Tanveer plans to get Sanam killed. Razia overhears Tanveer's plan but fails to warn Sunehri about it. Later, Sanam escapes from Razia's men.

videos.title: Episode 529
videos.overview: Sanam escapes from Razia's men. Tanveer's effort to kill Sunehri fails as Sunehri goes out of service area. Later, Faiz tells Haya that Rahat will divorce her after their wedding.

videos.title: Episode 530
videos.overview: Faiz shows Haya the clip in which Rahat tells Faiz that he will divorce Haya. Further, Haya is able to speak. Sanam's car explodes. Later, Razia again kidnaps Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 531
videos.overview: Aahil believes that Sanam is dead, but soon after, he is glad to see that she is alive. Sunehri tells Aahil how she was saved from the blast. Later, Haya returns to marry Rahat.

videos.title: Episode 532
videos.overview: Sanam hides inside a closet and finds the locket. She sees the picture of her lookalike and questions Razia about Sunehri. Meanwhile, everyone is elated to listen to Haya speak.

videos.title: Episode 533
videos.overview: Sanam learns about Seher's existence from Razia. Further, Seher stops Tanveer from leaving Haya's wedding. Thereafter, Sanam escapes from Razia's hold and goes to visit Seher.

videos.title: Episode 534
videos.overview: Sanam meets Seher, but the latter hits her on her head. Razia's men kidnap Sanam from the venue. Further, Aahil informs Tanveer about his desire to marry Sanam at the earliest.

videos.title: Episode 535
videos.overview: Razia tries to manipulate Sunehri, but Dilshad overhears them. Tanveer plans to destroy Aahil's plans of marrying Sanam. Further, Faiz tries to console a heartbroken Haya.

videos.title: Episode 536
videos.overview: Razia taunts Sanam about Aahil's nuptials with Seher. Rahat asks Haya to trust him, but she refuses to listen. Further, Rehaan feels that Sunehri has disguised herself as Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 537
videos.overview: Tanveer gives a dupatta to Sanam to wear during the party. Later, Razia tells Seher about Tanveer's ploy. When Tanveer reveals her plans of killing Sanam, Dilshad overhears her.

videos.title: Episode 538
videos.overview: Haya wears a western dress to the party and leaves with Faiz. At the party, Sanam wears Tanveer's dupatta. Later, Rahat rescues Haya from the goons, who try to misbehave with her.

videos.title: Episode 539
videos.overview: Sanam drinks the spiked juice and dances at the party. Faiz and Rahat argue with each other about Haya. Further, Tanveer sets fire to Sanam's dupatta with the desire to kill her.

videos.title: Episode 540
videos.overview: Tanveer learns that her plans of killing Sanam had failed. Tanveer tries to instigate Aahil against Sanam. Further, Rehaan asks Aahil and Tanveer to find out about the truth.

videos.title: Episode 541
videos.overview: Aahil mistakes Seher for Sanam and asks her if she really loves him. Thereafter, Rahat tries to pacify Haya by talking to her. Later, Tanveer and Seher warn each other.

videos.title: Episode 542
videos.overview: Sanam fails in her attempt to escape from her captivity and is drugged by the goons. Later, Dilshad reveals her identity to Seher in an attempt to stop her from marrying Aahil.

videos.title: Episode 543
videos.overview: Seher tells Dilshad that she knows Razia's den, which should help them find Sanam. Meanwhile, Faiz sabotages Haya and Rahat's relation by drugging Rahat and proving his infidelity.

videos.title: Episode 544
videos.overview: Seher finally finds Sanam, but a goon hits her from behind, rendering her unconscious. Meanwhile, Tanveer is delighted to hear that Sanam has escaped from the wedding venue.

videos.title: Episode 545
videos.overview: Seher tells Sanam about their shared family history, and Sanam is shocked to know Tanveer's secrets. Later, Dilshad reaches Razia's den and finds Seher and Sanam detained there.

videos.title: Episode 546
videos.overview: Razia demands a ransom from Seher to set Sanam free. However, Dilshad and Seher engage in a physical struggle with her. Meanwhile, Tanveer prevents Aahil from unveiling the bride.

videos.title: Episode 547
videos.overview: After Razia dies from electrocution, Dilshad wishes to visit Asad and Zoya's graves. Later, Aahil delivers a speech to the guests on how Sanam has improved him as a human being.

videos.title: Episode 548
videos.overview: Dilshad visits Asad and Zoya's graves and talks to them about Sanam and Seher. Meanwhile, Aahil is angry as he finds out that the bride is not Sanam, but an impostor.

videos.title: Episode 549
videos.overview: Haya imagines Faiz to be Rahat and faints. Tanveer tells Aahil that Sanam used him as a pawn to get the property from him. Later, Aahil misses Sanam and tries to call her.

videos.title: Episode 550
videos.overview: Aahil calls Sanam disloyal and swears to erase her memories. Further, Haya is shocked to learn that she slept with Faiz. Later, Sanam and Seher swear to take revenge on Tanveer.

videos.title: Episode 551
videos.overview: A drunk Aahil faints in Nayi Sanam's arms. Further, Tanveer asks Nayi Sanam to learn about Aahil's likes. Later, Haya informs Faiz that she will know about the masked man soon.

videos.title: Episode 552
videos.overview: Sanam learns that Aahil has married Nayi Sanam. Further, Haya and others watch the CD, but the disc gets corrupted. Later, Razaq and Gazalla throw Sanam out of the house.

videos.title: Episode 553
videos.overview: Razaq and Gazalla find out that Nayi Sanam helped Sanam, and they blackmail her. Further, Baba predicts that Tanveer will be punished for all her sins, but Tanveer refuses to believe him. Faiz tells Rahat that he won the challenge of taking Haya away from him and asks him to divorce her soon. Afterwards, Tanveer celebrates her victory at Asad and Zoya's cemetery. She admits ruining Sanam's life after doing the same to Zoya. Later, Tanveer gets surprised to find Sanam in the house.

videos.title: Episode 554
videos.overview: Seher fights back against Tanveer. Further, Sanam hides Seher in a secret room, which belonged to their parents. Later, Sanam threatens Gazalla to stay away from her.

videos.title: Episode 555
videos.overview: Sanam informs Tanveer that she murdered Aahil's father. Further, a furious Tanveer challenges Sanam that Aahil will evict her in a month, but Sanam swears to punish Tanveer.

videos.title: Episode 556
videos.overview: Gazalla and Razaq inform Tanveer that her work is done. Further, Rahat learns that the masked man is Faiz himself. Sanam and Seher lose consciousness after eating the food.

videos.title: Episode 557
videos.overview: Razaq and Gazalla find Seher's body in the corridor. They assume that she is Sanam and bury her in the graveyard. Meanwhile, Rahat tells Haya the truth about Faiz.

videos.title: Episode 558
videos.overview: Rahat finds out that Faiz tried to rape Haya and has kidnapped her. Elsewhere, Tanveer realises that Sanam is alive and decides to burn her dream house in order to draw her out.

videos.title: Episode 559
videos.overview: Nayi Sanam tells Sanam and Seher that she helped them after they were poisoned. Faiz takes Haya to a farmhouse. The police show Rahat, a letter and divorce papers, signed by Haya.

videos.title: Episode 560
videos.overview: Aahil decides that Sanam will live in his house as a servant. He plans to throw a party to announce that he loves Nayi Sanam. Later, Haya asks Faiz to let her go, but he refuses.

videos.title: Episode 561
videos.overview: Faiz decides to starve Haya until she agrees to consummate their relationship. He also decides to get rid of Rahat. Later, a dancer comes to Aahil's party.

videos.title: Episode 562
videos.overview: Faiz tips the police to search for Rahat's car. When they find Haya's clothes there, they arrest Rahat. Elsewhere, Sanam faints after the dance performance, and Aahil holds her.

videos.title: Episode 563
videos.overview: Faiz shows Haya a video of Rahat getting arrested. Elsewhere, Tanveer asks Aahil to test Sanam by asking her to transfer the property to his name.

videos.title: Episode 564
videos.overview: Seher replaces Sanam and agrees to sign the property papers. However, Aahil tears off the papers. Meanwhile, Haya pretends to be nice to Faiz in order to win his trust.

videos.title: Episode 565
videos.overview: Sanam decides to bring Aahil his mother’s favourite plants. Gazalla hires Rafiq to assassinate Sanam. Elsewhere, Haya tries to find a way to inform Rahat that she is alive.

videos.title: Episode 566
videos.overview: Gazalla and Tanveer try to save Sanam from dying. Meanwhile, Rahat receives Haya’s message from a stranger. Thereafter, he goes to a ‘dargah’, where Haya is expecting him.

videos.title: Episode 567
videos.overview: Tanveer intentionally falls down the stairs to blame Sanam for it. Meanwhile, Rahat spots Haya and Faiz. Afterwards, Tanveer accuses Sanam of trying to kill her.

videos.title: Episode 568
videos.overview: Sanam brings milk for Tanveer, who accuses Sanam of trying to poison her. When Aahil assures Tanveer that Sanam is not trying to kill her, Tanveer drinks the milk and faints.

videos.title: Episode 569
videos.overview: Razaq injects Tanveer with the antidote. Later, Tanveer gains consciousness and manipulates Aahil into believing that Sanam had tried to kill her. Hence, Aahil asks Sanam to leave.

videos.title: Episode 570
videos.overview: Rehaan reveals to Sanam that although he is Tanveer's biological son, she has been treating him like a servant. Aahil vows to Tanveer that he will never look at Sanam's face again.

videos.title: Episode 571
videos.overview: Rehaan asks Aahil not to get Sanam arrested as the milk that Tanveer had consumed had already been spoiled. At Faiz's residence, Haya attacks Faiz with a knife.

videos.title: Episode 572
videos.overview: Haya leaves Faiz to die and reaches Rahat's house. A group of surgeons, dressed as clerics, arrive to perform surgery on Tanveer. Sunehri tells Rehaan her New Year's resolution.

videos.title: Episode 573
videos.overview: Sanam, Seher and Rehaan swap the pieces of jewellery in the box with Rehaan's birth certificate in order to expose Tanveer's true self to Aahil. Later, Haya sees Faiz's ghost.

videos.title: Episode 574
videos.overview: Haya gets scared to see flames, but Rahat comforts her. Aahil learns that Rehaan is Tanveer's biological son and questions Tanveer. Later, Rahat puts a ring on Haya's finger.

videos.title: Episode 575
videos.overview: Tanveer tells Aahil that she had certain reasons for which she has loved Aahil like her own son and has denied Rehaan a mother's love. Later, Aahil gives Rehaan an amulet.

videos.title: Episode 576
videos.overview: Haya buys a bouquet of flowers for Rahat. Meanwhile, Nayi Sanam sees Aahil and Sanam in an intimate position. Rehaan tells Sunehri that Aahil has organised a function for Tanveer.

videos.title: Episode 577
videos.overview: Aahil gives a speech, honouring Tanveer. Later, Tanveer looks at Sanam's picture, and the pictures of the people she has killed. She also wonders how she had got her sight back.

videos.title: Episode 578
videos.overview: Razaq and Gazalla realise that Tanveer can see. Faiz hides in the trunk of Rahat and Haya's car. Meanwhile, both Sanam and Sunehri suspect that Tanveer can see.

videos.title: Episode 579
videos.overview: Tanveer succeeds in making Sunehri and Rehaan believe that she is blind. Later, Sunehri affectionately asks for Rehaan's forgiveness while Tanveer gets confused to see them.

videos.title: Episode 580
videos.overview: Sanam reveals Seher's identity to Rahat and Haya. Haya tells Sanam and Seher about 'Neele Chaand Ki Raat', and they get excited. Later, Faiz tries to get back into Haya's life.

videos.title: Episode 581
videos.overview: Tanveer asks Nayi Sanam to prepare for 'Neele Chaand Ki Raat'. She also sends Aahil and Rehaan to the garden. Faiz reaches Haya's house and has a bite of 'kheer' from her hand.

videos.title: Episode 582
videos.overview: Tanveer waits for Aahil to catch Sunehri with Rehaan. However, Aahil leaves when Nayi Sanam arrives. Tanveer realises that Seher is alive. Haya is afraid that Faiz might kill her.

videos.title: Episode 583
videos.overview: Nayi Sanam is vexed to see that Aahil still has feelings for Sanam. Haya is awakened by Faiz's voice, and he tries to scare her. Further, Tanveer plans a trap to harm Sunehri.

videos.title: Episode 584
videos.overview: Nayi Sanam decides to perform black magic on Sanam. Rahat adopts strict security measures for Haya's protection. Meanwhile, Tanveer fakes a call to dupe Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 585
videos.overview: Tanveer's plan to defame Seher and Aahil fails, as Seher switches places with Sanam. Later, Seher and Sanam crosswords with her. Meanwhile, Haya worries about Rahat's safety.

videos.title: Episode 586
videos.overview: Tanveer is impressed with Nayi Sanam's renewed zeal to win Aahil's love. Meanwhile, Nayi Sanam uses her spells on Aahil. Later, Tanveer reminds Aahil of Nawab's death anniversary.

videos.title: Episode 587
videos.overview: Nayi Sanam succeeds in preventing Sanam from going to the 'dargah' with Aahil. Sanam doubts Nayi Sanam after witnessing her changed behaviour. Rehaan pledges to expose Tanveer.

videos.title: Episode 588
videos.overview: Rehaan and Sanam fail to find any evidence in Tanveer's room. Meanwhile, Faiz kidnaps Rahat. Later, Sanam finds the missing newspaper that she had been frantically looking for.

videos.title: Episode 589
videos.overview: According to the plan, Nayi Sanam slips into Aahil's bed, and Tanveer calls Sanam to witness his infidelity. Later, Nayi Sanam insults Sanam for interfering in her conjugal life.

videos.title: Episode 590
videos.overview: Nayi Sanam lies to Aahil about their intimacy. Further, Sanam is hurt by Aahil's misbehaviour. Meanwhile, Tanveer fails to find Asad and Zoya's photograph in her room.

videos.title: Episode 591
videos.overview: Tanveer gets the newspaper clipping. When the reads the Quran, Nayi Sanam is unable to stand it. Later, Rahat falls from the terrace. Tanveer learns that her child is alive.

videos.title: Episode 592
videos.overview: Seher gets the newspaper cutting and asks Sanam and Rehaan to expose Tanveer. Aahil admits that he had killed Nawab and that Tanveer had saved him by taking the blame upon herself.

videos.title: Episode 593
videos.overview: Sanam proves Aahil's innocence in Anwar’s murder, much to his relief. Later, Faiz meets with an accident. At Seher's instigation, Aahil vows to bring the killer before Tanveer.

videos.title: Episode 594
videos.overview: Sanam and Seher learn that Tanveer can see. Further, Aahil tells Sanam about Suleiman and decides to seek his help. Haya dresses up as a widow. Later, the police question Faiz.

videos.title: Episode 595
videos.overview: At the doss-house, Tanveer learns that Jamila adopted her daughter. Suleiman tells Aahil that he is unaware of Tanveer's true colours. Haya withdraws her charge against Faiz.

videos.title: Episode 596
videos.overview: Suleiman dreads Tanveer and lies to Aahil. Further, Tanveer threatens Suleiman to leave the city, but Sanam urges him to tell Aahil the truth. Later, Haya decides to kill Faiz.

videos.title: Episode 597
videos.overview: Rehaan thwarts Tanveer's effort to stop him. Nayi Sanam informs Tanveer about Aahil and Suleiman's meeting. Later, She performs black magic to stop Aahil from meeting Suleiman.

videos.title: Episode 598
videos.overview: Nayi Sanam's magic works, as the tyre of Aahil's car gets punctured. Further, Aahil meets Sanam and Suleiman at a temple. Sanam asks Aahil not to disclose his location to Tanveer.

videos.title: Episode 599
videos.overview: Rehaan notices that Tanveer is about to kill Aahil and rushes to save him. Rehaan gets shot by Tanveer and dies instantly. Later, Nayi Sanam shoots Suleiman and drags Tanveer away.

videos.title: Episode 600
videos.overview: Nayi Sanam provokes Tanveer against Sanam and Seher. Haya seeks revenge against Faiz for his actions. Later, Sanam informs Seher about Rehaan's death, which leaves her heartbroken.

videos.title: Episode 601
videos.overview: Tanveer decides to seek revenge against Sanam and Seher. Seher goes to Rehaan's funeral, but Tanveer refuses to let her see the body. Later, Tanveer asks Aahil to take Sanam away.

videos.title: Episode 602
videos.overview: Seher is upset after seeing Rehaan's body from afar. At night, Seher visits Rehaan's grave, and Nayi Sanam hits her on her head. Later, Nayi Sanam coaxes Tanveer to seek revenge.

videos.title: Episode 603
videos.overview: Tanveer tells Sanam that she has kidnapped Seher and threatens to kill her. Faiz extends an inappropriate proposition to Haya. Sanam burns the diary while Aahil tries to stop her.

videos.title: Episode 604
videos.overview: Faiz tries to take advantage of Haya, but Rahat returns and stops him. Haya and Rahat reprimand Faiz for his actions. Later, Tanveer gives Sanam five minutes to save Seher.

videos.title: Episode 605
videos.overview: Faiz challenges Rahat to a fight, and they decide to battle each other. Further, Faiz falls on a sharp object and dies. Later, Sanam goes to save Seher and tries to untie her.

videos.title: Episode 606
videos.overview: Tanveer traps Sanam and Seher and also ties them up. Later, Nayi Sanam and Tanveer celebrate their success. Aahil receives clues about Anwar’s killer and decides to investigate.

videos.title: Episode 607
videos.overview: Tanveer searches for her daughter frantically and reaches the doll factory to talk to the imprisoned Nawab. Later, when Aahil finds a clue, he drives back to the factory.

videos.title: Episode 608
videos.overview: Tanveer tries to call her daughter but leaves a voice message when the call does not connect. Later, Sanam reveals Tanveer's secrets to Aahil, who is shocked.

videos.title: Episode 609
videos.overview: Sanam reveals Tanveer's dirty secrets to Aahil, who questions Tanveer. Thereafter, Tanveer takes Aahil to the basement and locks him up. Later, She prepares to shoot Seher.

videos.title: Episode 610
videos.overview: Aahil stops Sanam from shooting Tanveer. Later, Tanveer fires a cannon at the Qureshi family but is herself fatally hurt from the backward thrust of the cannon.

videos.title: Episode 611
videos.overview: Tanveer pushes Aahil away and says that he is not her son. Later, Sanam tells Aahil that the tumultuous phase in their lives has strengthened their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 612
videos.overview: Sanam and Aahil leave for the 'dargah' without Seher, who is to join them afterwards. Later, Sanam ties a 'tabeez' around Aahil's neck to stave off the forces of evil from him.

videos.title: Episode 613
videos.overview: Nayi Sanam imprisons Seher in a cage. She tells Seher that evil never ends but comes in different forms. Later, Nayi Sanam sends an imprisoned Seher's picture to Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 614
videos.overview: Nayi Sanam sells Seher to a prostitution racket. When Sanam learns about it, Nayi Sanam blackmails her. Later, Sanam finds the truck that is carrying Seher.

videos.title: Episode 615
videos.overview: Sanam looks for Seher in the truck while Seher sneaks out. Sanam gets trapped and enquires a girl about Seher. Further, Seher escapes from the goons but gets hit by a truck.

videos.title: Episode 616
videos.overview: Aahil looks for Sanam, but he is unable to find her. Thereafter, Gazalla and Razaq spy on Nayi Sanam. Later, Sanam gets thrown out of the truck and falls into a river.

videos.title: Episode 617
videos.overview: Sanam gains consciousness and finds herself in a deserted area. Further, Sanam loses her memory and asks commoners for help. Later, Nayi Sanam performs black magic on Aahil.

videos.title: Episode 618
videos.overview: Sanam flees after witnessing a murder. Further, Nayi Sanam learns that Sanam has disappeared after the truck met with an accident. Later, Aahil evicts Nayi Sanam from the house.

videos.title: Episode 619
videos.overview: Revolters chase Sanam to kill her, and she runs for her life. Thereafter, Shaad breaks down to find Liyaqat's dead body. Later, Shaad protects Sanam and fights the revolters.

videos.title: Episode 620
videos.overview: Nayi Sanam sends Aahil a picture of an imprisoned Sanam. Meanwhile, Sanam thinks herself to be Jannat, who is married to Shaad. Later, Shaad enquires Jannat about Liyaqat's murder.

videos.title: Episode 621
videos.overview: Aahil enquires Nayi Sanam about her injury. She lies to Aahil about Sanam being killed. Shaad takes Jannat to a clinic and learns that she lost her memory.

videos.title: Episode 622
videos.overview: Shaad plans to take revenge on Shashi for Liyaqat's death and keeps the file inside a secret vault. Thereafter, Shaad refuses to marry Misbah, but his father forces him.

videos.title: Episode 623
videos.overview: Shaad admits in front of everyone that Jannat is his wife. Further, Misbah is revealed to be Tanveer's daughter. Aahil takes Nayi Sanam to the doctor, and she fears being exposed.

videos.title: Episode 624
videos.overview: Aftaab asks Misbah to stay in his house. Elsewhere, the doctor spots a knife in Nayi Sanam's X-ray report, and she kills him. Later, a man carrying a gun sneaks into Shaad's house.

videos.title: Episode 625
videos.overview: Nayi Sanam finds out that Nazia is pregnant and decides to use it to her advantage. Later, she forces Aahil to announce her pregnancy to the media. Meanwhile, Jannat meets Misbah.

videos.title: Episode 626
videos.overview: Upon seeing Misbah's face, Jannat feels angry. Thereafter, Misbah advises Aftaab to organise a reception for Shaad and Jannat. A masked Shashi Kapoor plans to disrupt Shaad's life.

videos.title: Episode 627
videos.overview: Jannat gets angry when she sees Misbah. Hence, Misbah decides not to attend Shaad's reception. Elsewhere, Aahil misses Sanam, and Nayi Sanam asks him to forget her.

videos.title: Episode 628
videos.overview: Nayi Sanam blackmails Aahil. Huma tries to talk to Aahil regarding something important about Nayi Sanam. Meanwhile, everyone except Jannat faints at her wedding.

videos.title: Episode 629
videos.overview: Shashi finds the key to the locker where Shaad keeps the files. However, Jannat catches her trying to steal from the locker. Nayi Sanam finds Huma and makes her kill herself.

videos.title: Episode 630
videos.overview: The Pakistan army traces Jannat’s call to Aahil and arrives at Shaad’s house. Aahil learns that Nayi Sanam’s doctor has passed away. Shashi drops her fake thumb in a dustbin.

videos.title: Episode 631
videos.overview: Shashi retrieves her fake thumb. Meanwhile, Aahil finds that Nayi Sanam possesses apparatuses for performing black magic. Jannat asks Shaad to have her talk to her parents.

videos.title: Episode 632
videos.overview: Jannat dials Aahil’s number, but Aahil fails to receive her call. Later, Dilawar goes into a coma before giving Aahil the information about Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 633
videos.overview: Sanam fails to recognise Aahil when they talk over the phone. Meanwhile, Jannat catches Shashi trying to open Shaad's locker. Nayi Sanam finds out that Sanam is still alive.

videos.title: Episode 634
videos.overview: Shaad gives Jannat a watch that can send an SOS signal to him. Later, Jannat sends a distress signal to Shaad. He runs back to Jannat while leaving Shashi in his car.

videos.title: Episode 635
videos.overview: Shashi breaks the window of Shaad's car and comes out just before the bomb explodes. Meanwhile, Shaad interrupts Nayi Sanam before she can poison Jannat.

videos.title: Episode 636
videos.overview: Shaad tells Jannat the story of his mother. Later, Jannat tries to solve Shaad's problems. Nayi Sanam tells Razaq that Aahil will not accept Sanam even if she regains her memory.

videos.title: Episode 637
videos.overview: Shashi wants to kill Shaad and Jannat. Nayi Sanam draws Razaq's and Gazalla's blood and makes a magical potion with it. Later, Shaad recites a 'shayari' for Jannat.

videos.title: Episode 638
videos.overview: Jannat has visions of Aahil as Shaad is about to put a ring on her finger. Shashi crushes Shaad's watch. Later, Wahida tries to throw away Shashi's gun but fails.

videos.title: Episode 639
videos.overview: An armed Shashi accompanies Shaad, Jannat, Aftaab and Wahida to the tomb of Chand Bibi. Meanwhile, Nayi Sanam pours her potion into the pool and throws Aahil into it.

videos.title: Episode 640
videos.overview: A masked person kicks Shaad from the edge of a cliff. Later, Misbah locks Jannat inside a maze. Elsewhere, Aahil vows to punish Nayi Sanam as he knows about her evil plan.

videos.title: Episode 641
videos.overview: In Aahil's office, he asks an employee to keep Nayi Sanam busy while he makes a phone call to inquire about Sanam. Shaad enters a maze near the tomb of Chand Bibi to find Jannat.

videos.title: Episode 642
videos.overview: Shaad finds an injured Jannat. Aahil mistakenly shoots Nayi Sanam as he blames her for Sanam's death. Shaad thinks that Shashi is responsible for Jannat's condition.

videos.title: Episode 643
videos.overview: Jannat is curious about Misbah's identity, and she resolves to find out the truth. Aahil learns that Nayi Sanam is not pregnant. Jannat tries to find the keys to a locked room.

videos.title: Episode 644
videos.overview: Jannat finds a gun in Misbah's room, and she takes it. Later, Misbah takes the gun from Jannat's room. When Jannat tells Shaad about Misbah's gun, he finds it hard to believe.

videos.title: Episode 645
videos.overview: Nayi Sanam tries to entice Aahil, but he manages to escape her allurement. Jannat follows Misbah into an empty godown and learns that she has kept a lady hostage.

videos.title: Episode 646
videos.overview: Jannat learns that the lady hostage is the real Misbah. Further, she brings her home with her. Meanwhile, Nayi Sanam introduces Saif as Nazia's boyfriend to Aahil.

videos.title: Episode 647
videos.overview: The fake Misbah is worried to find the real Misbah missing. Nayi Sanam checks into a hotel with Saif, and Aahil follows them. The fake Misbah finds another woman in Jannat's room.

videos.title: Episode 648
videos.overview: Jannat fails to expose Shashi's ploy as she succeeds in kidnapping Misbah again. Meanwhile, Nayi Sanam's dress catches fire as she tries to get close to Saif in the hotel room.

videos.title: Episode 649
videos.overview: Jannat finds an excuse to search the house to find Misbah. Meanwhile, Nayi Sanam is horrified to learn the reason behind Aahil's plan to test the truth of her pregnancy.

videos.title: Episode 650
videos.overview: Jannat fails to find Misbah. Further, Nayi Sanam makes up an excuse for not taking the pregnancy test as she does not find Nazia. Later, the immigration officer arrests Jannat.

videos.title: Episode 651
videos.overview: Aahil refuses to accept the test results and demands a paternity test. Jannat stuns Shashi's men and manages to escape. Nayi Sanam reveals the name of the father of her child.

videos.title: Episode 652
videos.overview: Aahil seeks advice from Nayi Sanam's mother. Meanwhile, Jannat returns home and is shocked to find Misbah's dead body. Later, Shashi holds Jannat at gunpoint as Wahida exposes her.

videos.title: Episode 653
videos.overview: While Jannat prevents Shashi from killing Aftaab, Nayi Sanam tells Aahil about Nazia's pregnancy. Later, Shashi tries to strike a deal with Jannat to extract the file.

videos.title: Episode 654
videos.overview: Tanveer tries to scare Jannat by suffocating her with gas. Further, Nazia is ready for her engagement with Saif. However, Saif wants to be with Nayi Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 655
videos.overview: Tanveer kills Wahida and flees. Shaad follows her in an attempt to capture her. At the ring ceremony, Saif expresses his love for Nayi Sanam but completes the ceremony with Nazia.

videos.title: Episode 656
videos.overview: Tanveer apparently dies after a fall. Shaad identifies the fingers of the dead body. Further, Jannat and Shaad visit India. Aahil is confident that fate will unite him with Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 657
videos.overview: Jannat and Shaad meet Mithilesh in Delhi. Shashi tries to create an explosion. Aahil conspires to escape from the trip. Further, Aahil believes that he is destined to meet Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 658
videos.overview: Mithilesh tries to ruin Shashi's attempt of the bombing. Shaad and Aahil encounter each other. Later, Jannat and Aahil accidentally exchange a few words at the airport shoe store.

videos.title: Episode 659
videos.overview: Aahil helps Shaad to diffuse the bomb. Further, Mithilesh detains Nayi Sanam. Meanwhile, Shashi escapes from the police. Later, Aahil goes to Dharamshala to get rid of Nayi Sanam.

videos.title: Episode 660
videos.overview: Coincidentally, Aahil, Shaad and Jannat stay at the same hotel. Nayi Sanam tries to romance Saif but is interrupted. Meanwhile, Aahil likes the scarf that Jannat chooses for Shaad.

videos.title: Episode 661
videos.overview: On hearing Aahil's voice, Jannat tries to follow him. Shaad learns that someone has already asked the artist to sketch Jannat's portrait. Later, Nayi Sanam is shocked to see Nazia.
